integrity: The proof is analytic. The accompanying finite computations only replay exact identities and numerically check the asymptotic against the source formulas; they are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to the source's translation-invariant \(z_0=1\) branch. It does not classify the full two-variable boundary-law system, nontranslation-invariant measures, extremality, stability, or thermodynamic dominance. The asymptotic is for each fixed integer \(k\ge2\), not uniformly in \(k\).
title: Cusp opening of the external-field fold window in the three-state SOS tree model
